title: Tier-3 outer LED ring comment claims 180°/alternating geometry; code implements a 90° offset with both rings fully populated
detail: With leds=16 (stride=1) the outer ring covers all 16 positions at a +4 (90°) offset, so every angle has both an inner and an outer LED — contradicting the comment's 180° 'ONE LED alternating' claim. Rendered double ring still satisfies look-book A3; the comment misdescribes the geometry.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to 'offset by 4 positions (90°), both rings fully populated', or change the offset to +8 if the alternating 180° layout was actually intended.
